family: All Boolean truth tables for n=0,1,2,3 (pilot); all Boolean truth tables for n=4 (separate exhaustive job); explicit point defects and dictator surgeries for n=2,...,12; majority3 times point defect for n=2,...,8
domain: Dimensions are fixed explicitly; no automatic dimension increase
symmetry: None; all truth tables included, including complementary functions
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transform, integer superset maxima, Fraction for family identities; no floating entropy is accepted as a proof
checks: all spectral shifts for finite tensor witnesses
